info.name: Swish Analytics Sportsbook ATP Tennis Bet Request API

params.name: parlay
params.description: Specifies if this is a bet request for an accumulator (true) or a single market (false)

params.name: margin
params.description: Specifies the margin you would like applied to the returned market. Margin must be a value from 0 to 1 & accepts up to 3 decimal places

params.name: marketAdj
params.description: Specifies if this is a request for markets using our market adjusted (true) or non-market adjusted (false) lines

params.name: sport
params.description: Specifies the sport associated with each leg you are requesting per props object

params.name: gameId
params.description: Specifies the unique gameId associated with each leg you are requesting per props object

params.name: playerId
params.description: Specifies the unique playerId associated with each leg you are requesting per props object

params.name: teamId
params.description: Specifies the unique teamId associated with each leg you are requesting per props object. When requesting match-level markets that are not specifically tied to one team, teamId is still required, but either teamId from the match is allowed

params.name: statTypeId
params.description: Specifies the unique statTypeId associated with each leg you are requesting per props object

params.name: lineType
params.description: Specifies the selection of the bet associated with each leg you are requesting per props object

params.name: line
params.description: Specifies the specific line of the bet associated with each leg you are requesting per props object

params.name: ignoreNegCorrelation
params.description: Specifies whether you want your request to return a price without negative correlation adjustments (true) or with negative correlation adjustments (false). This parameter is optional; if you do not include it, each request will continue to default to stan

params.name: type
params.description: Specific to Soccer, this parameter notates the type of resulting you are requesting as it pertains to whether or not a player started the match or substituted. For example: passing prematch would void markets for players that did not start the match, whereas passing inplay would not void if a player does not start the match if they enter the game as a substitute.
